name: Suguru Geto
knownAs: The Worst of All Curse Users

abilities.name: Cursed Spirit Manipulation
abilities.description: Allows Geto to absorb and control cursed spirits after defeating them.

abilities.name: Maximum: Uzumaki
abilities.description: Combines a large number of stored cursed spirits into one powerful attack.

abilities.name: Cursed Spirit Arsenal
abilities.description: Geto can deploy a wide range of cursed spirits with different abilities.

abilities.name: Master Hand-to-Hand Combat
abilities.description: Geto is a highly skilled close-quarters fighter who can fight without relying on curses.

abilities.name: Curtain
abilities.description: A barrier technique that can hide or trap people within a chosen area.

abilities.name: Playful Cloud
abilities.description: Geto is a skilled user of the special grade three-section cursed tool.
